## What's new in 0.3.6

**Downloads, untangled.**
- A download only counts as finished once it really is. Half-finished downloads that looked complete (and got stuck halfway when played) now show as incomplete with a resume button, and carry on from where they stopped.
- Deleting a download and downloading it again starts cleanly: no more instant "complete", and the new download shows up straight away.
- If a download can't start (e.g. the chosen format is gone), you're told why instead of nothing happening. "Download started" now appears only once it really has.
- One button for all downloads that shows what it does (*Resume downloads* / *Pause downloads*), always in step with each video's own button. Downloads waiting for a free slot show as *Queued*.
- Shorter progress label that fits, e.g. "40/120 MB".

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/capheproject/BetterTube#changelog).
